findings.detail: B01 uses all 1,328 XBRL leaves as its denominator even though fair value is a distinct fact population; the 655 extracted fair-value facts reconcile to the complete schedule total.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation decides the flag. The raw schedule reports Total Investments fair value of $405,398,306 at table 18 row 47, exactly equal to the extracted fund-quarter fair value of $405.398306 million, with zero reported residual. Nearby investment rows 40-44 also each display a fair-value amount. The 49.3% metric instead divides 655 fair-value facts by 1,328 heterogeneous XBRL leaves, so the denominator does not represent positions that should each carry fair value. The source therefore supports complete fair-value extraction and shows B01 is a false alarm caused by rule scope/anchor design.
